blocSchemes.nameEn: Recommendations to the President for prime minister

sources.quote: President Reuven Rivlin subtracted Balad, one of the parties making up the Joint List, from the recommendations for Blue and White leader Benny Gantz to be prime minister. This put Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in the lead, with 55 recommendations to Gantz's 54 ... The remaining Knesset seats belong to Yisrael Beytenu, which chose to recommend no one ... "the recommendation is by 10 MKs of Hadash, UAL and Ta'al, and not 13," Tibi wrote to Rivlin.

המפלגות: הליכוד (32), ש"ס (9), יהדות התורה (7) וימינה (7) המליצו על נתניהו (ס"ה 55), והמפלגות: כחול לבן (33), העבודה-גשר (6), המחנה הדמוקרטי (5) וחלק מחברי הרשימה המשותפת (10 מתוך 13) המליצו על גנץ (ס"ה 54), מפלגת ישראל ביתנו (8) וחברי סיעת בל"ד (3) לא המליצו על אף מועמד (ס"ה 11)

notes: Consultations were held on 22–23 September 2019. The Joint List recommended Gantz in the name of its 13 MKs; Balad's 3 MKs then withdrew from the recommendation by letter, and the President counted 10. Replaced the headline-only Jerusalem Post citation with the body of its 24 September 2019 report (5 November 2026).
